source: First-party objekts methodology with explicitly educational structure, not observed MAGIE departments

departments.central_question: What business or artistic outcome makes this project worth making?
departments.teach: Objective vs film idea, awareness vs conversion, who decides
departments.output: Owner statement + evidence map
departments.exit_gate: An outcome stated without made-up KPIs
departments.noncommercial_exception: Story may have no business objective
departments.common_failure: A beautiful image can hide a missing proposition

departments.central_question: Whose situation and knowledge must this film address?
departments.teach: Audience circumstance, category conventions, competing experiences, evidence limits
departments.output: Research brief and verified/assumed insight list
departments.exit_gate: Observed findings separated from suppositions
departments.noncommercial_exception: For fiction use intended audience, not segmentation
departments.common_failure: An assumed demographic becomes a fake insight

departments.central_question: What visual proposition makes this work memorable, distinct and appropriate?
departments.teach: Creative territory, visual analogy, product role, distinction and copy
departments.output: Chosen one-line premise, message hierarchy, abandoned routes
departments.exit_gate: Author knows why this idea rather than a generic spectacular image
departments.noncommercial_exception: No CTA imposed on cinema
departments.common_failure: Brand added only at the end

departments.central_question: What unfolds through actions, changes and audience inferences?
departments.teach: Want/obstacle/action/shift, image-led narrative, causal and poetic links
departments.output: Live synopsis, scene cards, beat graph, treatment
departments.exit_gate: Another reader can tell what changes and what remains intentionally open
departments.noncommercial_exception: Abstract cinema may have no protagonist
departments.common_failure: Confusing chronology with causation

departments.central_question: Why are events shown this way and through whose knowledge?
departments.teach: Point of view, dramatic emphasis, temporal withholding, action design
departments.output: Directorial treatment, shot functions, scene intent
departments.exit_gate: Chosen staging changes the audience inference deliberately
departments.noncommercial_exception: Explicitly allow mood as scene function
departments.common_failure: Technical coverage mistaken for mise-en-scène

departments.central_question: What playable action occurs, where, and with which eyelines?
departments.teach: Actors act through objective/tactic, spatial relationships, gesture physics
departments.output: Playable action list, blocking chart, eye-line notes
departments.exit_gate: Gesture physically supports intended dramatic beat
departments.noncommercial_exception: If no human characters, track object/material agency
departments.common_failure: Asking a performer to just look emotional

departments.central_question: Which person or identity must persist through scenes?
departments.teach: Visual anatomy, silhouette, wardrobe/age, identity rights and continuity
departments.output: Character bible, identity references, consent status
departments.exit_gate: Every change is approved and multi-shot identity can be checked
departments.noncommercial_exception: Omit casting where no character exists
departments.common_failure: Same character described only by generic style

departments.central_question: What geometry, period, spatial logic and material rules control the world?
departments.teach: Architecture authority, props, historical accuracy, material interaction
departments.output: World bible, plan/geometry, prop masters, palette constraints
departments.exit_gate: Scene geometry consistent with approved anchors
departments.noncommercial_exception: Single abstract space can be sufficient
departments.common_failure: A collage of mood images falsely treated as floor plan

departments.central_question: What garments and objects communicate meaning and stay materially consistent?
departments.teach: Cut, seams, fabric, wear, prop action, product material fidelity
departments.output: Wardrobe/prop sheet and continuity rules
departments.exit_gate: Construction and interaction survive shot changes
departments.noncommercial_exception: Not applicable to fully abstract compositions
departments.common_failure: Uncontrolled product/wardrobe morphing

departments.central_question: Does each image represent a shot with a function and relation to the next?
departments.teach: Shot geometry, entrances/exits, focal hierarchy, screen direction, cut points
departments.output: Shot cards, board, animatic proposal
departments.exit_gate: Editor could reconstruct intended sequence without guessing
departments.noncommercial_exception: One-shot film can have one storyboard shot
departments.common_failure: Beautiful independent pictures labeled a storyboard

departments.central_question: What viewpoint, optics, perspective and motivated light produce this meaning?
departments.teach: Angle, camera height, POV, framing, lens families, depth, WB, contrast
departments.output: Camera grammar, lighting plan, format references
departments.exit_gate: Optics/light motivation specified, no fabricated EXIF
departments.noncommercial_exception: Illustration/animation can use optical analogy selectively
departments.common_failure: Arbitrary 35mm 1.4 in all prompts

departments.central_question: Which visual rules define the film across shots?
departments.teach: Color separation, materials, tone curve, texture, style sources and negatives
departments.output: Look bible, styleframes with authority domains
departments.exit_gate: Consistent source priority and reviewed style tests
departments.noncommercial_exception: Mixed-media styles may be intentional
departments.common_failure: Default neon/gloss or style soup

departments.central_question: What needs persistent and exact 3D spatial truth?
departments.teach: Reusable meshes, product geometry, camera tracking, surfaces, rigging
departments.output: CG asset specification, geometry masters, render passes
departments.exit_gate: Exact subjects survive shot motion with measured acceptance
departments.noncommercial_exception: Not every shot needs CGI
departments.common_failure: Letting generation mutate logo, packaging or topology

departments.central_question: Which variables can be generated and which are locked?
departments.teach: Frame/master authority, motion physics, temporal stability, sampling scope
departments.output: Generation plan, reference map, negative canon, minimal PoC
departments.exit_gate: One high-risk uncertainty tested before shot multiplication
departments.noncommercial_exception: Non-generative production route may be best
departments.common_failure: Unbounded prompt rerolls for structural failure

departments.central_question: How do altered elements occupy the same physical and optical space?
departments.teach: Occlusion, matte, motion vectors, grain, blur, shadows, reflections
departments.output: Compositing pass plan, integration acceptance, plate needs
departments.exit_gate: Depth/optic consistency checked at cut
departments.noncommercial_exception: Entirely illustrated film may have no footage integration
departments.common_failure: Sharp insert in optically soft background

departments.central_question: How do graphic elements move and remain legally/visually exact?
departments.teach: Hierarchy, typeface licenses, grid, kineticism, supers, logo
departments.output: Motion board, brand graphics spec, safe zones
departments.exit_gate: Text exact and legible on all versions
departments.noncommercial_exception: Narrative film may require no graphic language
departments.common_failure: Generated gibberish substituted for approved copy

departments.central_question: How do images connect into one film instead of demos?
departments.teach: Temporal topology, action overlap, motivation, variation, duration
departments.output: Paper edit, timeline, cutdown topology, pickup list
departments.exit_gate: Sequence works as one whole with readable causality/intent
departments.noncommercial_exception: Durational film need not maximize cutting
departments.common_failure: Selecting pretty clips rather than usable cut states

departments.central_question: What sounds establish cause, perspective, rhythm or brand?
departments.teach: Diegetic/non-diegetic cues, timing, prelap, silence, licensing
departments.output: Sound event map, music/voice rights, mix notes
departments.exit_gate: Sound supports on-screen actions and rights are accounted for
departments.noncommercial_exception: Silent work may be a deliberate decision
departments.common_failure: Unlicensed popular track in final advert

departments.central_question: Does light/color/material remain coherent across versions?
departments.teach: Color pipeline, displays, grain, halation, contrast, QC and sync
departments.output: Grade bible, finishing checklist, master specifications
departments.exit_gate: No unintended drift in approved identity/product tones
departments.noncommercial_exception: May be deliberately ungraded raw footage
departments.common_failure: Shot-by-shot grades conflict with sequence logic

departments.central_question: What material is legal, accurate and approved for this use?
departments.teach: Assets rights, product claims, likeness/voice, licensed refs, geography
departments.output: Rights register, claim provenance, approvals, red flags
departments.exit_gate: No fabricated efficacy or unconsented media transfer
departments.noncommercial_exception: A personal sketch might not need ad compliance
departments.common_failure: Confusing reference permission with reproduction rights

departments.central_question: What are the actual media deliverables and acceptance checks?
departments.teach: Aspect ratio recomposition, platform specs, subtitles, legal text
departments.output: Deliverable matrix, per-version QA, acceptance tests
departments.exit_gate: Every requested master/version has checked visual/technical status
departments.noncommercial_exception: Artist may only need one master
departments.common_failure: Calling all vertical crops derivative by default

departments.central_question: Who approves what and which test reduces risk earliest?
departments.teach: Scope, milestones, quote readiness, dependencies, handoff, budget disclosure
departments.output: Production roadmap, risks, PoC, decision owner, handoff packet
departments.exit_gate: Approval provenance intact, no implied purchase or send
departments.noncommercial_exception: DIY route remains valid
departments.common_failure: Claiming client sign-off or human estimate from AI model
